Clear Space

Logo Don'ts
✗ Stretch

Never distort or change proportions

✗ Fade

Never place on low-contrast or busy backgrounds

✗ Rotate

Never tilt or rotate the logo

✗ Squish

Never compress the vertical or horizontal axis

06

Brand Voice

Ylopo is a next-generation Complete Digital Marketing Solution designed to help agents and teams make more money, save time, be seen everywhere, and grow.

Confident
We speak with authority about what we know works. No hedging, no fluff — just clear, direct communication about real results.
Lead with outcomes, not features
Use active voice
Cite specific results when possible
Human
We're talking to real estate professionals — people with goals, deadlines, and clients to serve. We speak like a smart colleague, not a corporation.
Avoid jargon and buzzwords
Write at a 7th–8th grade reading level
Use "you" over "the user"
Energetic
Ylopo moves fast and so do our clients. Our tone is forward-moving, growth-oriented, and optimistic — without being hype-y or salesy.
Use short, punchy sentences
Favor verbs: grow, convert, win, close
Avoid passive constructions
